Officer's narrative
Officers responded to a reported two-vehicle collision in Katy, Texas, involving a low-speed head-on impact. Driver 1
was operating a sedan westbound when it struck the front of a sport utility vehicle operated by Driver 2. Driver 1
stated that the impact caused a wrist injury and was unable to say at the scene whether the symptoms were new or
related to an earlier condition. Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat of the sedan and confirmed being in
the vehicle at the time of the collision. Responding officers observed front-end damage to both vehicles that is
consistent with the reported impact, and scene photographs document the same areas of contact. No independent
witnesses were located, and no statements from bystanders were obtained. Officers found no indication of prior
damage to either vehicle. Driver 1 is listed as a household member of the policyholder, who resides at the same
address, and was identified as an authorized operator of the sedan. Further medical review will be needed before any
link between the reported wrist injury and this collision can be determined.
</page>
